import sys

def max_journey_length(s):
    n = len(s)
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        dp[i + 1] = dp[i]
        j = i
        while j >= 1 and s[j - 1] == s[i]:
            dp[i + 1] = max(dp[i + 1], dp[j - 1] + 1)
            j -= 1
    return dp[n]

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
s = input[1]
print(max_journey_length(s))
